Mild enhancement and virtually no necrosis are more typical of lower‑grade, IDH‑mutant tumors than of IDH‑wildtype glioblastoma, which usually shows strong enhancement and necrosis. These features together favor an IDH‑mutant status, while the presence of any enhancement is the only element that could argue for wildtype, but it is minimal.
